title: Aeropuerto Arturo Merino Benítez 23 — FINAL v2
subtitle: DGAC Don Nicolas — Legal Framework & 'Atados de Mano' Admission
location: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport (SCL), Santiago, Chile — DGAC Office
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential

participants.role: DGAC Higher Official — framework explanation; reveals criminal classification
DGAC Official — supporting; confirms 24h ban info
LATAM random employee — sympathetic but powerless

cluster_A_captain_authority.summary: Don Nicolas explains the Código Aeronáutico framework. 'Por las razones que fueran' — motive-blind admission.

cluster_B_pasajero_disruptivo.summary: 'No importa para este efecto el motivo' — disruption classification is motive-blind.

cluster_C_discrimination_question.summary: Leandro asks directly about discrimination. Don Nicolas does not deny it.

cluster_D_atados_de_mano.summary: CRITICAL: Don Nicolas admits DGAC is 'atados de mano' — cannot question airline.

cluster_E_law_reform_advocacy.summary: Don Nicolas reveals internal discussion and advocates for law reform.

cluster_F_criminal_classification.summary: CRITICAL: LATAM 'estampó la denuncia' — Leandro classified Categoría 3 with potential cárcel.

cluster_G_tokyo_convention_invocation.summary: Don Nicolas invokes Tokyo Convention to justify criminal classification.

cluster_H_barraza_name_coincidence.summary: Leandro identifies Barraza surname shared by LATAM security and PDI chief. Edgardo dismisses as coincidence.

cluster_I_random_staff_interaction.summary: Random LATAM employee listens sympathetically; 'Puede ser' when told it was retaliation.

cluster_J_false_equivalence_analogy.summary: Son/car accident analogy used to erase false accusation as originating cause.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Captain's absolute authority under Código Aeronáutico explained by DGAC.
'No importa para este efecto el motivo' — disruption classification is motive-blind.
'Esto puede ser simplemente discriminación?!' — discrimination question raised directly.
'Atados de mano' — DGAC cannot question airline's removal decision.
'No le podemos preguntar por qué' — DGAC cannot ask the reason.
'Para eso existen los tribunales' — only courts can check bad-faith invocations.
Don Nicolas advocates for law reform — 'se cambie esa parte de la normativa'.
Leandro quantifies damages: replacement flight 3x cost, 38hr vs 4hr.
CRIMINAL CLASSIFICATION THREAT: LATAM 'estampó la denuncia' — Categoría 3 with potential 'multa o sanción o cárcel'.
Ley 20.831 Art. 127 read by Leandro; Edgardo deflects: '¿Y quién es el transportador?'
Tokyo Convention invoked to justify criminal classification — without acknowledging valid-reason requirement.
Barraza name coincidence: LATAM security representative and PDI chief share surname.
Random LATAM employee's 'Puede ser' when told it was retaliation — pattern acknowledgment.
Son/car accident false equivalence analogy — erases false accusation as originating cause.

corrections_applied.note: Speakers normalized: Don Nicolas (higher official), Edgardo Ortiz, DGAC Official 3, LATAM random staff, Passenger.
Added correction notes throughout documenting communication tactics: deflection, victimization, condescension, false equivalence.
